Tomato___Bacterial_spot.name: Bacterial Spot
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.note: Bacterial. Avoid working in the field when leaves are wet.

Tomato___Early_blight.name: Early Blight
Tomato___Early_blight.note: Fungal. Mulch soil and remove infected lower leaves.

Tomato___Late_blight.name: Late Blight
Tomato___Late_blight.note: Spreads fast in humid weather. Spray before rain, not during.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.name: Leaf Mold
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.note: Common in polyhouses. Improve ventilation and reduce humidity.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.name: Septoria Leaf Spot
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.note: Fungal. Remove crop debris after harvest to stop carry-over.

Tomato___Spider_mites_Two-spotted_spider.name: Spider Mites
Tomato___Spider_mites_Two-spotted_spider.frequency: Spray on undersides, repeat after 10 days
Tomato___Spider_mites_Two-spotted_spider.note: A pest, not a disease. Worse in hot, dry weather.

Tomato___Target_Spot.name: Target Spot
Tomato___Target_Spot.note: Fungal. Rotate fungicide groups to avoid resistance.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.name: Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.frequency: Spray + remove and destroy infected plants
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.note: Viral, spread by whiteflies. No cure — control the insect and rogue out sick plants.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.name: Mosaic Virus
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.frequency: Remove infected plants; wash hands & tools; control aphids
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.note: Viral. Spreads by touch and tools. Do not smoke near plants (tobacco carries it).

Tomato___healthy.name: Healthy
